feature: Deck statuses — New and Draft, and the phase as a word
note: Seven values now, and the claim is that the two PHASE words are legible beside the five count words — which is a claim about a GRID, so the /decks rows carry the fixtures side by side and the sheet is read across rather than down. `New` and `Draft` are the pair to look at: both are drawn from text colours rather than a hue, so in greyscale the dashed edge on `Draft` is the only thing between them. The deck page rows exist because its pill is the ONLY place that page states the phase — #730's mono line under the bar is retired with the marks it belonged to. Home's row is here because it carries the word beside the touched stamp, which is the pair a picture shows and a test cannot. Set MARKS_PLAN to a deck with no version and MARKS_MOVED to a committed deck whose draft has moved; `scripts/probe-deck-statuses.mjs` builds exactly those shapes if the account owns neither. PRECONDITION, and it cost a whole run: the account must already have dismissed the current ABOUT_VERSION. The gate redirects every route to /about until it is, and the first run of this sheet photographed /about in all twelve cells and read as coverage of nothing. It is not a step here because the dismissal is stored per ACCOUNT in the database rather than per browser — press `Got it` once as this account and every later run is clean, while a `Got it` step in the rows times out from the second row onward. The /decks rows SEARCH for the fixtures rather than photographing the whole grid: the account carries 37 decks and the words have to sit beside each other for the picture to be the claim. The FACET rows live in `deck-state-facet.json`: this inventory's `shares` block asserts every row draws the same `StatusPillBadge`, and the filter rows legitimately draw a filter — `check:shared` failed them for composing the right thing, which is the check working.
